ar: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
en: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will be rewarded according to what they intended.

ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Cleanliness is half of faith.

ar: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
en: Whoever follows a path to seek knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.

ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
en: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.
The best of people are those most beneficial to others.
A good word is charity.
Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
Your smile in the face of your brother is charity.
Indeed Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.

ar: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
en: The deeds most loved by Allah are those done consistently, even if small.

ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُصِبْ مِنْهُ
en: If Allah wants good for someone, He afflicts him with trials.
This world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَجْسَادِكُمْ وَلَا إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ
en: Indeed Allah does not look at your bodies or appearances, but He looks at your hearts.
Whoever remains silent is saved.
Those who show mercy will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful.
Charity does not decrease wealth.

ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلًا أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
en: Indeed Allah loves that when one of you does a job, he does it with excellence.

ar: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
en: The strong man is not the one who can wrestle others down. The strong man is the one who controls himself when angry.

ar: مَنْ كَظَمَ غَيْظًا وَهُوَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يُنْفِذَهُ دَعَاهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الْخَلَائِقِ
en: Whoever suppresses his anger while able to act on it, Allah will call him before all creation on the Day of Judgment.
Paradise lies beneath the feet of mothers.
The best of you is the one who is best to his wife.

ar: مَنْ حَسُنَ إِسْلَامُ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
en: Part of the perfection of one's Islam is leaving aside what does not concern him.
Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you.
Fear Allah wherever you are.
Whoever humbles himself for Allah, Allah will raise his status.
Modesty is part of faith.
Whoever cheats us is not one of us.

ar: إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُمْ مُيَسِّرِينَ وَلَمْ تُبْعَثُوا مُعَسِّرِينَ
en: You have been sent to make things easy, and not to make them difficult.

ar: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
en: Make things easy and do not make them difficult, give glad tidings and do not repel people.
Indeed Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness.
Whoever is deprived of gentleness is deprived of goodness.

ar: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer.
When Allah loves a servant, He tests him.

ar: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
en: Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah will send ten blessings upon him.

ar: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ
en: The closest a servant comes to his Lord is while he is in prostration.
Supplication is worship.

ar: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
en: Whoever says there is no deity but Allah will enter Paradise.

ar: إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحْسَنَكُمْ خُلُقًا
en: The most beloved of you to me and closest to me in sitting on the Day of Judgment is the one with the best character.
